senses.gloss:
एकी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to unite, associate, join together; combine.

एकी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become
one, to join together, blend, combine, mingle.
—एकी-
भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, blending together, contracted.
—एकी-भाव, अस्, m. becoming one, combination,
association; common nature or property.
—एकी-
भाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, relating to the blending of vowels
or accents.

एकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to one, proceeding
from one; belonging to the same party; a partisan
or associate, a companion.
